section.content: 本实用新型公开种锂离子电池组，所述锂离子电池组包括模组盒体及安装于所述模组盒体内的多个锂离子电池，所述多个锂离子电池通过串和/或并联连接形成电池组单元，所述电池组单元呈环形布设以在所述模组盒体内共同围设形成空置区域。在所述电池组单元的中间热量聚集的区域不安置锂离子电池，使得所述电池组单元中间区域散热，平均所述电池组单元中每个所述锂离子电池的热量，使得每个所述锂离子电池在相同热量状态下工作，优化所述锂离子电池的寿命的致性，具有较好的效果。

The utility model discloses a kind of Li-ion batteries piles, the Li-ion batteries piles include module case as one and the multiple lithium ion batteries being installed in the module case as one, the multiple lithium ion battery to form battery assembly module by going here and there and/or being connected in parallel, and the battery assembly module is laid to form an idle area to enclose to set jointly in the module case as one in a ring.Lithium ion battery is not disposed in the region that the middle heat of the battery assembly module is assembled, so that the battery assembly module intermediate region radiating, the heat of each lithium ion battery in the average battery assembly module, so that each lithium ion battery works under identical Quantity of heat, optimize the uniformity in the life-span of the lithium ion battery, there is preferable effect.

Li-ion batteries pilesTechnical field

It the utility model is related to lithium battery temperature control technology field, more particularly to a kind of Li-ion batteries piles.

Background technology

Battery pack in low current in use, battery pack radiating mode usually uses natural heat dissipation mode, but in battery pack Portion's local temperature is still very high, corresponding to be distributed in the high region of temperature, the lost of life of battery, so as to cause in whole battery pack Battery life is inconsistent.

Utility model content

Main purpose of the present utility model is to propose a kind of Li-ion batteries piles, it is intended to Li-ion batteries piles central region Radiating treatment is carried out, to optimize the uniformity in the life-span of the lithium ion battery.

To achieve the above object, the utility model proposes Li-ion batteries piles, including module case as one and be installed on described Multiple lithium ion batteries in module case as one, the multiple lithium ion battery to form battery pack list by going here and there and/or being connected in parallel Member, the battery assembly module are laid to form an idle area to enclose to set jointly in the module case as one in a ring.

Preferably, the battery assembly module includes two battery pack base units, and each battery pack base unit is L-shaped to be set Put；

Described two battery pack base units in being oppositely arranged so that the battery assembly module formed in the middle it is described vacant Region.

Preferably, the battery assembly module includes multiple battery pack base units, and each battery pack base unit is set in I types Put；

The multiple battery pack base unit is set in a ring so that the battery assembly module formed in the middle it is described vacant Region.

Preferably, the idle area is the accommodating chamber of a upper end open, and phase-change material is filled in the accommodating chamber.

Preferably, the phase-change material is paraffin or expanded graphite.

Preferably, the Li-ion batteries piles also include：

Mounting seat, is installed on the bottom of the module case as one, and the multiple lithium ion battery is installed in the mounting seat； And

Fan, in the mounting seat, and the corresponding idle area is set.

Preferably, the Li-ion batteries piles also include liquid cooling structure, and the liquid cooling structure is installed on the idle area It is interior.

Preferably, the liquid cooling structure is a liquid cold containers, and the liquid cold containers include input and output end, the liquid Cold liquid in cold containers transmits heat by the input and the output end.

Preferably, the idle area is the accommodating chamber of a upper end open, and the liquid cooling structure includes：

Thermal conductive insulator, it is installed on the madial wall of the accommodating chamber；

The cold pipe of liquid, is installed on the thermal conductive insulator；And

Cold liquid, circulate in the cold pipe of the liquid.

Preferably, the liquid cooling structure is set multiple.

In technical scheme provided by the utility model, the multiple lithium ion battery connects to form battery by series and parallel Group unit, the battery assembly module is set to form idle area in the middle in a ring, i.e., in the battery assembly module Between the region assembled of heat do not dispose lithium ion battery so that battery assembly module intermediate region radiating, the average battery The heat of each lithium ion battery in group unit so that each lithium ion battery works under identical Quantity of heat, Optimize the uniformity in the life-span of the lithium ion battery, there is preferable effect.

Referring to Fig. 1, the Li-ion batteries piles 100 include module case as one 17 and are installed in the module case as one 17 Multiple lithium ion batteries 111, the multiple lithium ion battery 111 to form battery assembly module 1, institute by going here and there and/or being connected in parallel Battery assembly module 1 is stated to set to form an idle area 12 to enclose to set jointly in the module case as one 17 in a ring.

In manufacturing process, the Li-ion batteries piles 100 are first dressed up into multiple battery pack base units 11, then by described in Battery pack base unit 11 is combined into the Li-ion batteries piles 100.

Specifically, referring to Fig. 2, the battery assembly module 1 includes two battery pack base units 11, each battery pack The 11 L-shaped setting of base unit, described two battery pack base units 11 are in being oppositely arranged, so that the battery assembly module 1 is wherein Portion forms the idle area 12, and the battery pack base unit 11 that L-type is set is when in groups into the battery assembly module 1, only Two battery pack base units 11 need to be oppositely arranged, that is, the two right angles opposition for forming the L-type is set, structure installation Simply, production efficiency is high.

Certain battery assembly module 1 also has other block structures, and specifically, the battery assembly module 1 includes multiple Battery pack base unit 11, each battery pack base unit 11 are set in I types, and the multiple battery pack base unit 11 is set in a ring Put, so that the battery assembly module 1 forms the idle area 12 in the middle, i.e., the multiple head and the tail of battery pack base unit 11 It is connected, and sets in a ring, the battery pack base unit 11 is set in I types can be combined into different size of idle area 12, For different battery packs, the idle area 12 of optimal size is formed, ensures the heat control of the whole Li-ion batteries piles 100 System, facilitate the heat management of the Li-ion batteries piles 100.

In order to further reduce the temperature in the idle area 12, increase can be led in the idle area 12 Hot material and conductive structure further radiate, and reduce the heat accumulation of the idle area 12.

Specifically, referring to Fig. 2, in second embodiment provided by the utility model, the idle area 12 is on one The accommodating chamber 12a of end opening, the accommodating chamber 12a is sealed around, and phase-change material 13, the phase are filled in the accommodating chamber 12a Become material 13 and absorb the heat for being gathered in centre, balance the heat of the lithium ion battery 111, optimize the lithium ion battery The uniformity in 111 life-span, there is preferable effect, in the present embodiment, the phase-change material 13 is paraffin or expansion stone Ink, ensure balance heat, while there is preferable electrical security.

In 3rd embodiment provided by the utility model, referring to Fig. 3, the Li-ion batteries piles 100 also include peace Dress seat 14 and fan 15, the mounting seat 14 are installed on the bottom of the module case as one 17, and the multiple lithium ion battery 111 is pacified Loaded in the mounting seat 14, the fan 15, in the mounting seat 14, and the corresponding idle area 12 is set, and is led to Mechanical fan 15 is crossed, it is directly higher by the air-cooled heat for reducing the idle area 12, electrical security.

In fourth embodiment provided by the utility model and the 5th embodiment, the Li-ion batteries piles 100 also include Liquid cooling structure 16, the liquid cooling structure 16 are installed in the idle area 12, by liquid cooling structure 16, by the idle area The heat derives of aggregation in 12.

Specifically, in fourth embodiment provided by the utility model, Fig. 4 and Fig. 5 are referred to, the liquid cooling structure 16 is One liquid cold containers 163, the liquid cold containers 163 include input 164 and output end 165, the cold liquid in the liquid cold containers 163 Heat is transmitted by the input 164 and the output end 165, a liquid cold containers are directly disposed in the idle area 12 163, a low-temperature receiver is disposed equivalent in the idle area 12, the heat that the idle area 12 is assembled constantly is absorbed, passes through The flowing at the cold night, exported from the output end 165.

In the 5th embodiment provided by the utility model, referring to Fig. 6, the idle area 12 is a upper end open Accommodating chamber, the liquid cooling structure 16 include thermal conductive insulator 161, the cold pipe 162 of liquid and cold liquid, the thermal conductive insulator 161, installation In the madial wall of the accommodating chamber, the cold pipe 162 of liquid is installed in the thermal conductive insulator 161, the cold liquid, circulates in institute State in the cold pipe 162 of liquid, heat is imported in the cold night pipe by the thermal conductive insulator 161, the heat derives have Good heat-conducting effect.

Further, the installation region includes four side walls, and the liquid cooling structure 16 sets multiple, and is arranged in institute State in four side walls, certainly, when the volume ratio of liquid cooling structure 16 is less, can be set in each side wall multiple The liquid cooling structure 16, when the volume of liquid cooling structure 16 is moderate, the liquid can be set in each side wall Air-cooled structure 16, the heat derives that multiple liquid cooling structures 16 will be concentrated in each side wall, there is more preferable heat-conducting effect.
